proves: The legacy driver has a physical WriteFile boundary that can target Region A if its 3072-byte LBA7 entry is mounted and receives a virtual write.
does_not_prove: That any of the sampled disks took the fallback, mounted Region A, or wrote the captured bytes through this driver path.
